g.text: AWS COMMUNITY BUILDER · ENTERPRISE SSO ARCHITECTURE
Learning Enterprise SSO on AWS: Ping Identity (ForgeRock) AM with MFA
Terraform Devbox · SSM Port Forwarding · Zero Inbound Rules · Docker Compose · PingAM 8.1 + Dual PingDS · OIDC TOTP Flow · Total Cost $3.03
Routes cleanly into local SSM tunnel port :8080
Ping Identity Evaluation ForgeOps Stack (Internal Docker Bridge Network)
Injects AM & DS passwords at boot without git leaks
AWS Logs agent collecting Docker stdout JSON
Logs Insights queries for MFA attempts & tokens
No IAM access keys or static credentials on EC2!
END-TO-END OPENID CONNECT (OIDC) SIGN-IN WITH TOTP MFA — COMPLETE CLIENT JOURNEY
• AM renders Page Node login form
• Tree routes to OATH Token Verifier
• AM issues signed JWT ID Token + Access Token
Every node outcome (User credentials, TOTP validation, Code grant, Token issue) is written as structured JSON to Docker stdout and streamed into Amazon CloudWatch Logs for full compliance auditing.
